intro: Who has access to this space. A removed member loses access at once, API tokens included; the documents they created stay.
confirmRemove: Really remove {name} from the space? They lose access and their API tokens in this space at once.
confirmOwnRole: Really change your own role? You may lose rights you have now.

link.label: Invitation link for {email}
link.emailNotSent: E-mail not sent (SMTP is not configured) – pass the link on yourself.
link.sentByEmail: The link was sent by e-mail to {email}.
link.emailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent – try resending the invitation.
link.sentHint: The link is valid for 7 days and works once. If it does not arrive, resend the invitation.
link.hint: The link is valid for 7 days and works once. It is not shown again; if it gets lost, resend the invitation.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.confirmRevoke: Really revoke the invitation for {email}? The link stops working.

leave.title: Leave space
leave.intro: You lose access to the space {name}; your sessions and API tokens in it are revoked. The documents you created stay.
leave.confirm: Really leave the space {name}? Only a new invitation brings you back.
leave.lastOwner: You are the only owner of this space, so you cannot leave it. First make another member an owner in Settings → Members, or delete the space.

accept.title: Space invitation
accept.intro: You have been invited to the space {name} as {role}.
accept.existing: An account with this e-mail already exists. Accept the invitation with its password.
accept.new: There is no account with this e-mail yet. Create one with your name and a password.
accept.invalid: The invitation is invalid, already used, replaced by a newer one or expired. Ask for a new one.
accept.requireMfaExisting: This space requires two-factor authentication. If you have it on, enter the code from your app as well.
accept.requireMfaNew: This space requires two-factor authentication. After creating the account you will have to turn it on before joining.

mfa.existing: The space {name} requires two-factor authentication, which your account does not have. The invitation stays valid.
mfa.created: Your account is created. The space {name} requires two-factor authentication, so you have not joined yet. The invitation stays valid.
mfa.link: Go to your account on the main site

steps.login: Sign in on the main site with your e-mail and password.
steps.enable: Turn on two-factor authentication in your account.
